If you record the ID and then crash before processing, the event is lost; if you process and then fail to record the ID, it will be processed again. Recording both in the same transaction avoids either outcome.

frontmatter.title: Idempotency and Duplicate Events
frontmatter.description: Most webhook providers deliver events at least once, so every consumer eventually receives the same event twice. Providers that send a stable, unique event ID make deduplication simple.
